THREE-A RESOURCES BERHAD KLSE Summary
Three-A Resources Berhad is a Malaysia-based investment holding company. The principal activities of its subsidiaries are primarily involved in the manufacturing and sale of food and beverage ingredients, and investment holding. The Company’s product portfolio includes liquid caramel, caramel color, fermented vinegar, distilled vinegar, rice vinegar, glucose syrup, high maltose syrup, liquid maltodextrin, soya protein sauce (SPS), caramel powder, maltodextrin, and golden syrup. The Company’s geographical segments include Malaysia, Singapore, and other countries. Its subsidiaries are San Soon Seng Food Industries Sdn. Bhd. and Three-A Food Industries (M) Sdn. Bhd. San Soon Seng Food Industries Sdn. Bhd. is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of soya protein sauce, vinegar, and other food and beverage ingredients, while Three-A Food Industries (M) Sdn. Bhd. is engaged in the investment holding business.

Website: http://www.three-a.com.my

Main Market : Food & Beverages
